title: Run the readiness preflight
proves: Configuration is complete, test-mode, and non-production before anything else happens.

title: Confirm the key is test mode at Stripe
proves: The key Stripe actually accepts is a test key, not merely a test-shaped string.

title: Retrieve the Basic and Pro prices
proves: Both configured price IDs exist, are active, and are recurring monthly.

title: Match prices against the server allow-list
proves: The prices the server will accept as paid are exactly the prices being tested ($49 / $99).

title: Register a disposable academy
proves: A clean tenant exists in the isolated test database with a 30-day no-card trial.

title: Create the gym's Stripe customer
proves: ensureCustomer() creates exactly one customer carrying the gymId in metadata.

title: Re-run customer creation concurrently
proves: The server-owned idempotency key prevents a second customer for the same gym.

title: Open a Basic subscription Checkout Session
proves: Checkout is created in subscription mode against the Basic price.

title: Complete checkout with a Stripe test card
proves: A test-mode subscription can actually be paid for end to end.

title: Deliver checkout.session.completed
proves: The signed webhook reaches the app and is verified against the signing secret.

title: Assert stored status is active on Basic
proves: The Gym row reflects Stripe: status active, Basic price persisted.

title: Assert the 100-member Basic limit is server-enforced
proves: Entitlement is enforced on the server, not merely displayed in the UI.

title: Attempt a second checkout for the same gym
proves: A gym with a live subscription is routed to the portal and cannot double-subscribe.

title: Replay the same webhook event id
proves: Reprocessing an already-seen event changes nothing (duplicate delivery is safe).

title: Switch Basic → Pro via the Customer Portal
proves: Plan switching is configured in the portal and emits customer.subscription.updated.

title: Assert unlimited members on Pro
proves: The stored price changed and the member cap is lifted server-side.

title: Force a payment failure to past_due
proves: invoice.payment_failed is handled and the stored status becomes past_due.

title: Cancel the subscription
proves: customer.subscription.deleted is handled and the stored status becomes canceled.

title: Assert paid entitlement is revoked
proves: A canceled academy loses paid capability rather than coasting on stale state.

title: Resubscribe, then write the object manifest
proves: A churned academy can return, and every created test object is recorded for cleanup.
